name: Nurse Appreciation Ceramic Coffee Mug (11 oz)
metaDescription: An 11 oz ceramic nurse mug that makes a simple, warm thank you for Nurses Week. Easy to give to one nurse or to several coworkers on a unit.
summary: A classic 11 oz ceramic coffee mug with a nurse theme. A simple, budget friendly way to say thanks during Nurses Week.
whyItWorks: Coffee is practically part of the uniform on most units. Nurses grab a cup before report, reheat it three times, and usually finish it cold somewhere around hour ten. A mug made for them is one of those gifts that actually gets used, either at home before a shift or on a desk at a clinic or school.

The 11 oz size is the standard everyday mug, which makes it a safe pick if you are not sure how someone takes their coffee. It is an easy gift for Nurses Week, a thank you after a hospital stay, or a Secret Santa draw where you know the person is a nurse but not much else. We like it best when it carries a little extra, like a bag of good coffee beans or a gift card to the cafe near the hospital. It keeps things thoughtful without becoming a big production, and it is the kind of present a nurse can keep on the shelf for years.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the exact design and wording before ordering.
Confirm on the listing whether it is microwave and dishwasher safe.
Fill it with candy or coffee packets to make it feel more complete.

faq.q: Is an 11 oz mug big enough for a nurse?
faq.a: It is a standard coffee mug size, so it works well for home or a desk. For a long shift on the go, a larger insulated tumbler may suit better.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse you do not know well?
faq.a: Yes. A nurse themed mug is a friendly, low pressure choice for coworkers, Secret Santa, or a thank you to a care team.
